_source: ST Success plan short form videos - Google Doc from Logan Rawlings, 2026-10-22. The unpersonalised originals; every student copy is one of these with [Name & Brokerage] filled in.
_why: Before this, the script was guessed from the transcript by keyword, and the UPLOAD TITLE was trusted. Both were wrong. Video 04 is filed as 'Curb Appeal' and is word-for-word script 3, 'Thinking About Buying?'. Matching the real text settles it.

scripts.title: Why Hire A Realtor
scripts.hook: The biggest mistake sellers make costs them an average of $47,000... and 90% don't even know they're making it.
scripts.body: Here's what happens: They hire discount brokers to save on commission. Big mistake. Hi, I'm [Name & Brokerage]. Your home is your largest investment - you wouldn't perform surgery on yourself, right? Discount agents can't negotiate because they don't have the skills or market knowledge. If they can't negotiate their own commission, how can they negotiate for YOU? Experience and negotiation expertise aren't luxuries - they're necessities when dealing with your biggest asset. Don't let this costly mistake happen to you when it's time to sell.

scripts.title: How Quickly Will My Home Sell
scripts.hook: Here's why getting 12 offers in 3 days might actually be BAD news for sellers...
scripts.body: The truth about timing that most agents won't tell you. I'm [Name and Brokerage]. In hot markets, homes sell in days - but sellers often leave $50k+ on the table by accepting the first offer. In slower markets, homes taking longer than normal are usually overpriced. The secret? Absorption rates. Above 20% = seller's market. Below 15% = buyer's market. Most agents don't even track this data. Understanding your local market timing can mean the difference between leaving money on the table and getting top dollar.

scripts.title: Thinking About Buying
scripts.hook: Why do 73% of buyers lose their first 3 dream homes? It's not what you think...
scripts.body: It's because they don't have proper representation. The seller's agent only looks out for the seller, and unrepresented buyers get crushed in negotiations. Hi, I'm [Name] with [Brokerage]. Here's what changes everything: Expert guidance through finding homes, making competitive offers that actually get accepted, navigating inspections, and protecting your deposit from day one to keys. The right agent knows the strategies that win - even in multiple offer situations. Don't be another buyer who loses out because they tried to go it alone. We're here to guide you to homeownership success.

scripts.title: Curb Appeal
scripts.hook: Two identical houses on the same street... one sold for $40k more. Here's the only difference...
scripts.body: It came down to these 4 things that most sellers completely ignore. I'm [Name & Brokerage]. First - power wash EVERYTHING. Driveway, sidewalk, house exterior. Fresh paint on front door and trim - no peeling paint or cobwebs. Second - professional staging. 77% of agents say it helps buyers visualize living there. Staged homes sell for 10% more on average. Third - professional photos and video. 67% of buyers visit homes they saw online first. Bad photos = no showings. Fourth - be ready to show anytime. Until you're under contract, flexibility is crucial. These simple steps consistently get sellers maximum value. Don't leave money on the table when selling your home.

scripts.title: Digital Marketing
scripts.hook: 95% of agents post your home once and pray... while the top 1% are getting 10,000+ views in the first week.
scripts.body: Most agents think a yard sign and MLS listing is enough. That's why homes sit on the market. I'm [Name & Brokerage]. 95% of buyers search online, 77% use social media, yet only 16% of agents use social media marketing - and only 1% do it correctly. Strategic digital marketing uses Fortune 500 techniques to place your home in front of thousands of qualified buyers weekly. You're probably watching this as proof it works. Make sure your agent has a comprehensive digital strategy, not just basic listing exposure.

scripts.title: Approval vs Pre-Qual
scripts.hook: Being 'pre-qualified' means absolutely nothing... Here's what actually matters.
scripts.body: Pre-qualification is just a conversation - nothing verified. Real approval changes everything. I'm [Name] with [Brokerage]. Full approval means the lender verified employment, taxes, bank statements - everything. They know your exact loan amount and payment. Without proper approval, buyers lose deposits and thousands spent on inspections. It happens more often than you think. Don't be the buyer who loses their dream home because of incomplete paperwork. Get fully approved before you start shopping.

scripts.title: Tips to Get Your Offer Accepted
scripts.hook: In today's market, the highest offer doesn't always win... here's what actually does.
scripts.body: Strategy beats money every time. I'm [Name & Brokerage], and here's what wins bidding wars: Strategy 1: Price competitively. Lowball offers get ignored immediately. Strategy 2: Larger earnest money shows you're serious and qualified. But never remove contingencies until you're 100% approved. Strategy 3: Strategic contingency removal. Clean inspections? Remove inspection contingency. Full loan approval? Remove loan contingency. Strategy 4: Personalize your offer. Show them why you love THEIR home specifically. These strategies consistently get offers accepted, even against higher bids. Work with an agent who knows how to position you to win.

scripts.title: Should I Get Pre-Listing Inspections
scripts.hook: Smart sellers are doing this ONE thing before listing... and it's saving them $50k+ in negotiations.
scripts.body: They get pre-inspections and discover issues before buyers do. Game changer. I'm [Name & Brokerage]. Here's why this works: No surprises during escrow, full control over repair costs, and buyers pay full price because they know exactly what they're getting. Major termite damage, roof issues, AC problems - imagine discovering these during escrow when you have zero negotiating power and need money for your next home. Pre-inspections give you control and peace of mind about your net proceeds. Consider this strategy to protect yourself during the sale process.

scripts.title: What to Expect When Buying
scripts.hook: First-time buyers make this $50k mistake because no one tells them about this critical first step...
scripts.body: They skip getting fully qualified first and make offers on homes they can't afford. Don't let this be you. Hi, I'm [Name] with [Brokerage]. Here's the proven process: First, full qualification - know your exact budget and loan terms. Then strategic house hunting in neighborhoods that appreciate. Next, offer strategy that wins - even against cash. Then protection during escrow - ensuring every deadline is met so you never lose your deposit. Buying a home is complex, but with the right guidance, you can avoid costly mistakes and secure your dream home successfully. We're here to guide you through every step.

scripts.title: How Much Money Do I Need
scripts.hook: Think you need $100k to buy a home? This might surprise you...
scripts.body: People are buying dream homes with just $7,500 down using programs most don't know exist. Hi, I'm [Name & Brokerage]. First-time buyer programs, VA loans, USDA rural loans, state and local grants - there are dozens of options with 3% down, even ZERO down. Buyers are purchasing with as little as $5k total out of pocket. Your biggest obstacle isn't money, it's not knowing your options. Don't let down payment fears keep you from homeownership when so many programs exist to help you.

scripts.title: 10 Must-Nots When Buying
scripts.hook: This loan got denied 2 days before closing because of one innocent purchase... here's what happened.
scripts.body: They bought a car during escrow. Dream home gone, deposit lost. Here are the 10 deadly mistakes to avoid once you're under contract: Don't change jobs or quit. Don't buy ANY vehicle. Don't use credit cards or miss payments. Don't spend your closing money. Don't hide debts from your lender. Don't buy furniture - even with no payments. Don't let anyone run your credit. Don't make large deposits or withdrawals. Don't change banks. Don't co-sign for ANYONE. These mistakes kill home purchases every day. Follow these rules and protect your path to homeownership.

scripts.title: Will Your Home Pass The Test
scripts.hook: So you are thinking about putting your home on the market and you want to make sure that you're going to get the best return on your investment.
scripts.body: I'm [Name, Brokerage & Slogan]. Lets take the Top Dollar Test: Does it have curb appeal? Fresh landscaping, paint, power-washed everything? Have you decluttered, depersonalized, deep cleaned? Is your lawn green or dead? Walls neutral with no holes? Carpets clean or showing years of wear? Here's the big one - the SMELL TEST. Every home has a smell. Pets, cooking, life. Buyers notice everything. Updated flooring, counters, cabinets? Staged with modern furniture? Great view or looking into neighbors' windows? Most homes need changes to get top dollar, but the investment pays off. Make sure your home passes the test before listing.
